headline:
Control
costs.
narration: Everybody wants control. But control costs.

headline:
Separate reserves.
Specific jobs.
narration: Core provides two-sided liquidity. Other reserves have different jobs.

headline: When players sell.
narration: Sell through active downside ranges: Ether becomes OMR.

headline: When players buy.
narration: Buy through upside ranges: OMR becomes Ether.

headline: Crossed ≠ settled.
narration: Crossing isn't final. Until withdrawal, inventory can still convert back.

headline:
Remove.
Account.
narration: Finalization removes eligible positions, separating principal from fees.

headline: Capacity is spent.
narration: Deployment spends capacity. Deposits and withdrawals don't reset it.

headline: Observe the market.
narration: Completed pool history informs each move, checked against current conditions.

headline: Rules before action.
narration: Stress gates, cooldowns and capacity limit deployment.

headline: Fund the War Chest.
narration: Surge fees, bond proceeds and arbitrage shares fund the War Chest.

headline:
Recovery has
conditions.
narration: Refill requires a full window of spaced, healthy observations.

headline: The cap stays.
narration: Only actual idle assets move. Lifetime limits stay spent.

headline: No magic refill.
narration: A bounce creates no Ether. No guaranteed floor.

headline:
Where nine
percent goes.
narration: Canonical sells pay nine percent, split four ways.

headline:
Core and reserves
are separate.
narration: Three percent funds Core. Up to one extra percent funds stability.

headline: Read the receipt.
narration: Fees settle in Ether or OMR, including partial fills.

headline:
The opening
is temporary.
narration: Opening buys have temporary fees and limits. Afterwards, no Hook buy tax.

headline: One canonical pool.
narration: Other venues have their own rules. Pool liquidity fees are separate.

headline: Inventory bonds.
narration: Pay Ether for bonds backed by existing OMR, released through linear vesting.

headline:
A claim survives
a pause.
narration: No minting. No sellback. Purchasing pauses don't erase vested claims.

headline:
Arbitrage with
a committed plan.
narration: Solvers commit a plan, then fund a two-pool arbitrage cycle.

headline:
Profit is checked.
Gas is still risk.
narration: Profit is checked after costs and reserve share. Failed gas remains your risk.

headline:
Commit actual
liquidity.
narration: Lock canonical position NFTs. Rewards require fresh, qualifying depth samples.

headline:
Funding limits
the reward.
narration: Rewards need funded campaigns. Mature positions can exit independently.

headline: Liquidity territory.
narration: Families fight for seasonal Turf fees. The protocol keeps principal.

headline:
Alliances divide
rights.
narration: Syndicates split rights. Status doesn't multiply money.

headline:
Settle the past.
Then change control.
narration: A checkpoint assigns earned fees before control changes. Existing claims keep their recipients.

headline:
Only funded
escrow.
narration: Sieges freeze wallets and allocate only funded escrow.

headline: Close the season.
narration: At season exit, fees settle; principal returns for retirement.

headline: Bounded authority.
narration: The Safe binds and funds systems. Keepers have budgets. The game can't withdraw principal.

headline: Separate ledgers.
narration: Game cash, OMR, Ether and RWA stay separate.

headline:
What happens
next?
narration: Trades change inventory. Revenue funds reserves. Conditions gate the next move.

headline: Control costs.
narration: OMERTÀ. Control costs.
